recognize_zh: 血液抹片中多顆嗜酸性球顆粒分布不均、局部顆粒稀疏並有細胞質空泡（中央與右上方細胞最明顯），核分葉也不規則；成熟但異常的嗜酸性球（hypogranular、vacuolated）大量出現，配合 FIP1L1-PDGFRA 陽性即為 PDGFRA 重排的骨髓性/淋巴性腫瘤。
features: Increased eosinophils with abnormal morphology in a single field
Patchy hypogranulation with areas of cytoplasm devoid of granules and cytoplasmic vacuoles (center and upper-right cells)
Abnormal nuclear lobation: hyposegmented, band-like or multilobed nuclei
Other eosinophils (upper-left, lower-left) retain dense orange granules, showing heterogeneity
Small mature lymphocytes; red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; no blasts seen
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased eosinophils with dysplastic features, including patchy hypogranulation with granule-free cytoplasmic areas, cytoplasmic vacuolation and abnormal nuclear lobation ranging from band-like to multilobated forms. Other eosinophils retain dense granules, producing a heterogeneous population. Small lymphocytes are present, red cells are unremarkable, and no blasts are identified. These morphologic changes are nonspecific but in the setting of persistent eosinophilia with FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion and CHIC2 deletion, the findings are consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement (chronic eosinophilic leukemia phenotype).

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils can also be hypogranular and vacuolated, so the discriminator is molecular (FIP1L1-PDGFRA) and clinical exclusion of secondary causes.
Eosinophil morphology overlaps, but it is defined by an aberrant cytokine-producing T-cell population (e.g., CD3-CD4+) on flow cytometry and lacks PDGFRA fusion.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with FGFR1 or PDGFRB rearrangement
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar eosinophilia; separated by cytogenetics (8p11 or 5q32 rearrangement), with FGFR1 cases often presenting with T-lymphoblastic lymphoma or AML.
May show eosinophilia, but has a full left-shifted granulocytic spectrum with basophilia and BCR-ABL1, which was negative in this case.
